name: Remote home-cleaning booking brand
one_liner: Run a local cleaning brand online with upfront prices and instant booking, and send every job to independent local cleaners.
customer: Homeowners and renters in a target city who want a cleaner
offer: Home cleaning booked and paid online, priced by bedrooms, bathrooms, square footage and add-ons
how_it_makes_money: The customer pays the brand's price up front; the brand pays the subcontracted cleaner less and keeps the margin
startup_cost: low (website, Google Business listing, booking software; the presenter says his laptop is the only asset)
tools: Website with online booking and payments
evidence: One operator reportedly does $150,000/month and runs it while travelling (TR5bJ083igY)
College students reportedly hit $60,000/month working about 5 hours a month (TR5bJ083igY)
'As soon as they book, the job gets sent to a local cleaner in that area, a subcontractor' (TR5bJ083igY)
risks: Quality control and complaints when you don't employ the cleaners
Paid local search and ads can get expensive
UK employment-status risk if subcontractors look like employees
Revenue figures are 'reportedly', not verified

name: Semi-trailer leasing arbitrage
one_liner: Lease 53ft trailers from big leasing companies and sublet them to truckers at about twice the cost.
customer: Owner-operator truckers and small haulage firms
how_it_makes_money: Lease at about $350/month and rent out at about $750/month; the spread is recurring monthly profit
startup_cost: low (he says insurance was the only cost to start)
time_to_first_revenue: weeks; $7,500/month recurring within the first 2 months
evidence: 'Lease him a 53 ft semi-trailer... for about 350 bucks a month... rented it to his uncle for about 750' (PuogTln9CZw)
$7,500/month recurring in the first 2 months from Facebook Marketplace posts (PuogTln9CZw)
300 trailers and over $50k/month profit after 6 years, with 2 virtual employees, run from his phone in Colombia (PuogTln9CZw)
risks: US example; UK/EU haulage trailer leasing terms and insurance may differ
Counterparty risk: non-payment, damage or theft
You stay liable on the underlying lease if a renter defaults
Needs capital or credit to scale the fleet

name: AI-built websites for local businesses with no site
one_liner: Use an AI agent to find well-reviewed local businesses with no website or an outdated one, build each a ready-made site with booking, and pitch it to them.
customer: Local service businesses with good reviews but a poor or missing website
offer: A finished, personalised website with a booking system, plus optional upkeep
how_it_makes_money: Implementation fee per site, optionally a monthly hosting and maintenance retainer (no pricing stated)
evidence: The agent 'found local businesses that have great reviews, but no website or outdated websites... builds them an entirely new website... with a booking system' (GZbjmWNmIkc)
'That becomes your template that you then stamp out across all your clients' (GZbjmWNmIkc)
Weak: no revenue or pricing given
risks: Crowded market with falling prices
Cold outreach has low conversion
Must comply with UK and EU privacy rules (UK GDPR/PECR) when cold-emailing
No proof in the transcript that anyone pays

name: Email-list monetisation retainer
one_liner: Help business owners who have an email list but earn little from it make money from it with AI-run campaigns and an attached community.
customer: Small business owners and newsletter owners with existing lists
offer: Done-for-you AI email campaigns plus a community space linked to the newsletter
how_it_makes_money: Monthly retainer, about $1,000/month per client in the example
evidence: 'Pay you $1,000 a month to generate $12,000 a month for them?... Can you find 10 business owners' (zEmmeIWMNvQ)
'A big email list does not automatically turn into revenue' (zEmmeIWMNvQ)
Weak: the $12k figure is hypothetical, not a real case
risks: Results depend on how good the client's list is
Hard to prove the revenue you generated
Likely sales calls needed to close retainers

name: Estate sale company (lead generator)
one_liner: Run estate sales for families who are downsizing or settling an estate, keeping a share of sales, and use the jobs as a source of leads for a more profitable business.
customer: Families of retiring or deceased baby boomers, and people moving home
offer: A full-service on-site sale of household contents
how_it_makes_money: Commission on sales: you collect all the money and pass about 60% to the client
startup_cost: low (about $0: tape, price gun, phone POS, tables)
time_to_first_revenue: first week; up to $6,000 profit in week one
evidence: 'Start a business for literally 0 and make $6,000 profit your very first week' (E9baszgY3J8)
'Way more demand than supply' in any market (E9baszgY3J8)
'You pass on the 60%' to the client (E9baszgY3J8)
Braden reached six figures a year (E9baszgY3J8)
risks: In-person and physically heavy work
Estate sales are a US custom; UK equivalents are house clearance and auctions
Not async

name: AI premium rebranding for DTC products
one_liner: Use AI to reposition a commodity product as a premium brand with a persona and ad creative, so it can sell at several times the price.
customer: E-commerce sellers and small DTC brands
offer: Brand positioning, customer persona and AI-generated ad campaign visuals
how_it_makes_money: Project fee, or selling your own rebranded products at higher margins ($12 to $68 example)
evidence: 'Take this $12 water bottle and turn it into a $68 product' in about 3 hours (zK12R4Edm6k)
Weak: a demo only, with no sales evidence
risks: No proof premium prices actually sell
Tutorial includes an affiliate link to Higgsfield
AI branding is becoming a commodity

name: Premium dog walking and pet care
one_liner: Start walking dogs through marketplaces, then add premium services and a team.
offer: Walks, overnight stays, off-leash park visits, group hikes
how_it_makes_money: Per-walk and per-stay fees, with premium add-ons
time_to_first_revenue: days to weeks via Rover or Wag
evidence: One walker grew it to six figures by adding a team and premium services (pqCRdTa9eWI)

risks: In-person and time-bound
